crossbow.name: Archer's Crossbow
crossbow.note: Natalie's Archer won't be needing it tonight. Mind the reload.

sword.name: Practice Sword
sword.note: The smith's practice blade, from the stand outside the smithy. Click / RT / Swing to cut; three in a row ends in a heavy blow.

buckler.name: Wooden Buckler
buckler.note: A small round of oak with an iron boss, from the smith. Hold its hand's button to block: it turns any blow from straight ahead.

shield.name: Round Shield
shield.note: Oak, iron-rimmed, the smith's red band across it. Hold its hand's button to block a wide arc in front of you.

dagger.name: Dagger
dagger.note: Short and quick: cuts in half a sword's time, for less. Two make a flurry.

mace.name: Flanged Mace
mace.note: Slow and heavy. Every blow goes through a pot lid and knocks a goblin back.

spear.name: Ash Spear
spear.note: A long straight thrust: reach a goblin before it reaches you. A narrow point, so aim it.

sling.name: Shepherd's Sling
sling.note: Hold its hand's button to whirl it, let go to loose a rock. The longer the whirl, the farther and harder. Uses rocks.

rock.name: Rock
rock.note: A good fist-sized stone. Throw it from your hand, or loose it from a sling. Pick them up from rock piles, or where they land.

trinket.name: Trinket from below
trinket.note: Found in a chest under the library. Magister Greer would love to hear its story.

bolt.name: Crossbow Bolt
bolt.note: Pick spent bolts back up with E.

crown.name: Crown
crown.note: Town coin. Earned by finding things and by writing; spent at the General Store.

whistle.name: Tin Whistle
whistle.note: Six holes and a bright voice. Play it by the campfire.

drum.name: Hand Drum
drum.note: Goatskin over a hoop. Keeps a bard's time.

lute.name: Lute
lute.note: A travelling bard's lute, a little out of tune.

ocarina.name: Ocarina
ocarina.note: A clay egg with holes. Sustained, breathy notes.

violin.name: Violin
violin.note: Four strings and a bow. Carries the long notes at the fire.

candle.name: Tallow Candle
candle.note: A stub of tallow. Smells of the kitchen.

wax.name: Block of Wax
wax.note: For sealing letters, or a stuck drawer.

lampOil.name: Lamp Oil
lampOil.note: A small flask. Keep it upright.

soap.name: Bar of Soap
soap.note: Lye and lavender. The inn would thank you.

twine.name: Ball of Twine
twine.note: Good for parcels, snares and lost buttons.

chalk.name: Stick of Chalk
chalk.note: Mark a wall, a door, a way back out.

salt.name: Pouch of Salt
salt.note: For the pot. Some say for the doorstep too.

bread.name: Loaf of Bread
bread.note: Yesterday's, but still good. The dog by the inn would not say no.

fish.name: Dried Fish
fish.note: Salted and stiff. Every cat in town knows the smell.

jerky.name: Strip of Jerky
jerky.note: Tough dried meat. Owls take it from a gloved hand.

mealworms.name: Pot of Mealworms
mealworms.note: Wriggling and crunchy. A treat for something prickly.

seeds.name: Bag of Sunflower Seeds
seeds.note: Striped and salty. Something with big cheeks would carry off the lot.
